title: fix(console): "customized" means overrides + extensions everywhere; Setup → Packages names arrangements apart
body:
Fixes #37236

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在 设置 > 软件包 打开一个应用的详情时，「已定制」只数改过和新增的条目；只调整了排列的应用现在显示「已定制 0 项，调整排列 2 处，已停用 0 项」，不再显示「已定制 2 项」，排列明细照常列出。
- 属于 Studio 改版：按维护者裁定，「已定制」在设置详情、全部元数据页头和列表筛选里只有一个意思（覆盖 + 扩展）。
- 出错时管理员只会看到这一行数字或措辞不对，不碰任何数据，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- **Setup → Packages detail** (`PackageCustomizationsPanel.tsx`): the 「已定制」 / "customized" count is now `customizationTotal` (overrides + extensions), the one number the All metadata header and both lists' 「customized」 filter already read. Arrangements are named in their own segment, `engine.packages.customizations.arranged` (en `{count} rearranged`, zh-CN `调整排列 {count} 处`), drawn only when the count is above 0. The "No changes" line now needs all three counts at 0, so an arrangement-only app never reads "No changes".
  - Arrangement-only app: `0 customized, 2 rearranged, 0 switched off` / `已定制 0 项，调整排列 2 处，已停用 0 项`.
  - No arrangement: unchanged, `1 customized, 0 switched off`.
  - The rows (`customizationRowsOf`) and the 「布局」 tab are unchanged; arrangements are still listed.
- **`customizedCountOf` is retired**, not fixed to delegate. Its only job was the second meaning of 「已定制」. Keeping a second name for `customizationTotal` would leave two doors to the same number, and the drift this card fixes came in through that second door. Its one caller and its one test go with it.
- **`customizationTotal` is unchanged**, and so are the header (`DirectoryPage.tsx`) and both filters (`ResourceListPage.tsx`, `useListOrderedNames.ts`). They gain pins, not code.
- **i18n:** one additive key in en and zh-CN. No key is removed and no released key changes meaning (`engine.packages.customizations.customized` keeps its text, and it has not been released yet: it arrived with #37166's unreleased changeset).
- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION of an existing changeset**, `.changeset/36908-remove-studio-home.md` (unreleased). Its sentence "The count now includes tab, field-group and action-layout arrangements, so an app whose only change is a tab arrangement shows as customized." would ship false after this change. It now reads: "Tab, field-group and action-layout arrangements are named on their own in that line, not counted as customized."
- No server, spec or route change.

## Tests

One pin per surface, each on an arrangement-only base fixture (two arrangements, no override, no extension):

| Surface | Pin |
|:--|:--|
| Setup detail, en | `PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx`: arrangement-only app reads exactly `0 customized, 2 rearranged, 0 switched off`, both rows listed |
| Setup detail, zh-CN | same file: exactly `已定制 0 项，调整排列 1 处，已停用 0 项` |
| All metadata header | `metadataAreaHost.customizations-28568.test.tsx`: no `directory-customizations-total`, no tile, no failure line |
| ResourceListPage filter | same file: no `metadata-only-customizations` on the arrangement-only base's list |
| useListOrderedNames filter | same file: with `?customized=1`, the ‹ › names keep the row (the filter is not offered), with a HotCRM control that keeps only its customized row |

Also: no arrangement means no arrangement segment, and the mixed fixture now reads `2 customized, 1 rearranged, 1 switched off`.

## Acceptance notes

- Wording choice: en reads `{count} rearranged`, matching the line's other participles ("customized", "switched off") and avoiding "1 arrangements". zh-CN reads the ruling's own `调整排列 {count} 处`. The new segment uses the line's existing separator (`, ` / `，`), not the ruling example's ` · `, so the line has one separator.
- "Don't show a 0-count segment" is applied to the new segment only. The customized and switched-off segments keep #37166's behaviour (both always drawn once anything is non-zero), so an arrangement-only app still shows `0 customized`, as the card asks.

## Verification

Read first: `PackageCustomizationsPanel.tsx` (the summary line), then the new `describe` at the end of `metadataAreaHost.customizations-28568.test.tsx`.

Two-minute check: from `ui/`, `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx`. Expect 13 passed, including "an arrangement-only app reads 0 customized beside its arrangement count".
